meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建动画文本、图表、地图或UI动画等动态图形短片。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需快速制作无旁白的动态图形视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create kinetic typography, data charts, map animations, or UI motion graphics in seconds.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce short, design-led motion graphics without narration.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户提出制作短动画图形（如文字动画、数据统计、地图动画等）时，Claude会自动规划、搜索素材、设计、构建、验证并渲染出MP4或透明叠加视频，无需用户逐步指导。
howto.when: 用户通过`/hyperframes`指令或直接描述一个短动画图形需求（例如：“做一个标题动画”或“将这段数据做成动画图表”）时触发。

say.text: 制作一个文字动画：'科技改变未来'
say.note: 生成一个动感文字视频。

say.text: 把这份销售数据做成柱状图动画
say.note: 自动创建数据可视化动画。

say.text: 做一个地图动画，标出我们的门店位置
say.note: 生成带有地点标记的地图动画。

howto.what_en: When installed, upon user request for a short motion graphic (e.g., kinetic typography, stat count-up, map animation), Claude autonomously plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, and renders the animation into an MP4 or transparent overlay, without step-by-step guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user issues the `/hyperframes` command or describes a short motion graphic need (e.g., "animate a headline" or "turn this data into an animated chart").

say_en.text: Create a kinetic typography for 'Technology changes the future'
Turn this sales data into an animated bar chart
say_en.note: Automatically creates a data visualization animation.

say_en.text: Make an animated map highlighting our store locations
say_en.note: Generates a map animation with location markers.
